Oval.name: Classic Fade
Oval.description: A clean taper fade that highlights your balanced proportions. Oval faces carry almost any cut — this one keeps it sharp.

Oval.name: Textured Quiff
Oval.description: Volume on top with tapered sides. Your symmetrical face shape lets this style shine without overwhelming your features.

Oval.name: Side Part
Oval.description: A timeless cut that flatters oval faces. Clean lines and a defined part give you a polished, versatile look.

Oval.name: Buzz Cut
Oval.description: Oval faces are one of the few that look great with very short cuts. Clean, minimal, and confident.

Round.name: High Fade with Volume
Round.description: Height on top elongates your face visually. Keeping the sides tight draws the eye up and creates the illusion of length.

Round.name: Angular Fringe
Round.description: Sharp angles and a forward-swept fringe add structure to rounder features. Avoids adding width at the sides.

Round.name: Pompadour
Round.description: Classic volume up top with close-cropped sides. The vertical height counterbalances the width of a round face.

Round.name: Mohawk Fade
Round.description: A central strip of length with faded sides creates a strong vertical line. Bold and face-lengthening.

Square.name: Textured Crop
Square.description: Soft, textured layers on top soften a strong jawline. The crop length keeps it modern without fighting your natural structure.

Square.name: Layered Waves
Square.description: Natural waves and movement break up the angularity of a square face. Longer length draws attention away from the jaw.

Square.name: Undercut
Square.description: Shaved or closely cropped sides with longer length on top. The contrast emphasizes your strong bone structure in a controlled way.

Square.name: Messy Quiff
Square.description: A deliberately undone quiff introduces softness and movement. The messy texture counterbalances sharp jawline definition.

Heart.name: Side Swept Bangs
Heart.description: Sweeping volume toward the forehead narrows its appearance. This cut balances a wider forehead against a narrower chin.

Heart.name: Chin-Length Bob
Heart.description: Adding width at the chin with a bob balances the heart shape's natural narrowing. Frames the face beautifully.

Heart.name: Low Fade
Heart.description: Keeps width minimal up top to avoid emphasizing the wide forehead. Clean and understated.

Heart.name: Curtain Bangs
Heart.description: Center-parted bangs that fall to the sides soften a broad forehead and draw the eye to your eyes instead.

Diamond.name: Soft Fringe
Diamond.description: A forward fringe adds width to a narrow forehead, balancing diamond proportions from the top down.

Diamond.name: Full Volume Top
Diamond.description: Building volume at the crown counterbalances prominent cheekbones. Keeps the widest point from being the focus.

Diamond.name: Shaggy Layers
Diamond.description: Layered length with texture softens angular cheekbones. The natural movement makes diamond features read as chiseled, not sharp.

Long.name: Side Part with Volume
Long.description: Horizontal volume through a side part adds width, visually shortening a long face. Sweep to the side, not up.

Long.name: Curly Afro
Long.description: Natural volume that expands sideways rather than vertically. Ideal for widening a long face shape.

Long.name: Blunt Fringe
Long.description: A straight-across fringe shortens the visual length of the face. One of the most effective techniques for long face shapes.

Long.name: Layered Medium Cut
Long.description: Medium length with horizontal layers creates width. Avoid adding height on top — go for movement at the sides.
